notes.title: Karl BOOM will be available for free
notes.content:
Starting on 01/01/2023, Karl BOOM will be available for free. There will be no paid content.
This will hopefully motivate some new players to test the multiplayer mode!
Have fun!

notes.title: macOS Version of Karl BOOM released
notes.content: Karl BOOM has received an engine update and is finally available on MacOS! An M1 processor (or dedicated graphics card) is required. Have fun!

notes.title: Removed Steam DRM
notes.content: The latest patch updates the game engine and removes Steam DRM.

notes.title: Linux Version of Karl BOOM released
notes.content: After an engine update with several fixes, Karl BOOM can now also be played on Linux (Vulkan driver is required). Have fun!
